prompts.prompt: In one paragraph, explain to a smart non-engineer why a model that is fast at counting can be slow at writing prose when speculative decoding is on.

Compare vLLM UVA expert offload vs SGLang OffloaderV2 whole-layer copy for a 384-expert top-6 MoE. Output a markdown table with columns: approach, bytes moved per token, bottleneck, expected tok/s on a ~330 GB/s link. Then one sentence of verdict.
Status report format: 5 bullet points, each '<component>: <state> — <one metric>'. Components: weights load, KV cache, autotune, graph capture, API bind. Invent plausible values for a vLLM boot.

Write a Python function `knee(rows)` that takes [(conc, agg_tps)] and returns the concurrency where marginal gain per added stream first drops below 5 tok/s. Include a docstring and a 3-line example. Code only.
Write a bash script that loops over shards model-00001..00048-of-00048.safetensors, checks each exists in $SRC, and prints missing ones. Code only.

Give the exact sequence of shell commands to: stop docker container dsv41-vllm-v7, rename it with suffix -old, drop page caches with sudo, and relaunch via launch-dsv41-vllm.sh with OFFGB=70 SEQS=16. Commands only, one per line.
List the docker containers on host 192.0.2.9 and check free disk on /. Use tools.
Read /home/user/dsv41/launch-dsv41-vllm.sh then write a copy to /tmp/l2.sh with port 30007. Use tools; call read_file first.
Write a detailed paragraph about the number 7, its history and uses. No lists.
Write a detailed paragraph about the number 12, its history and uses. No lists.
Write a detailed paragraph about the number 42, its history and uses. No lists.
Write a detailed paragraph about the number 101, its history and uses. No lists.
Write a detailed paragraph about the number 256, its history and uses. No lists.
Write a detailed paragraph about the number 1024, its history and uses. No lists.
Write a 300-word reflective essay on why small studios should own their inference hardware. No lists.
Describe, in flowing prose, a morning walk through a mountain town in late September.
Write a typed Python function binary_search(xs: Sequence[int], target: int) -> int that returns the insertion index. Include a short docstring and two assert examples. Code only.
Implement an LRU cache in Python using OrderedDict with get/put O(1). Capacity is constructor arg. Code only, with a 6-line usage example.
Write a Rust function parse_csv_line(line: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, &'static str> that splits on commas, respects double quotes, and errors on unterminated quotes. Code only.
Show a small Rust example: read a u64 from a string, multiply by 3, return Result<u64, ParseIntError> with the ? operator. Include a main that prints the error. Code only.
Write a Swift async function fetchTitle(url: URL) async throws -> String using URLSession.shared.data(from:) and UTF-8 decoding. Code only.
Define a Swift Codable struct Recipe { name: String; tokPerSec: Double; tags: [String] } and a function that decodes a JSON string into [Recipe]. Code only.

Write a PostgreSQL query that ranks employees by salary within each department using RANK() and returns dept, name, salary, rnk for rnk <= 3. Assume table emp(dept text, name text, salary numeric). SQL only.
Write a recursive SQL CTE that expands an adjacency-list org chart table org(id int, parent_id int, name text) from root id=1 into id, name, depth. SQL only.
Write a Python argparse CLI that takes --input PATH and --limit N and prints the N longest lines. Use a dataclass for args. Code only.
Sketch a minimal Axum Rust handler GET /health that returns JSON {"ok": true, "ts": unix_secs}. Include the router bind on 0.0.0.0:8080. Code only.

A freight train leaves Denver at 06:00 at 48 mph. A passenger train leaves at 07:30 at 72 mph on the same track. In complete sentences, compute when and how far from Denver they meet. Show the algebra in prose.
Give a complete prose proof that sqrt(2) is irrational. No bullet lists. End with the contradiction named explicitly.
A club of 12 people chooses a 4-person committee that must include at least one of Alice or Bob. Compute the number of valid committees. Explain the counting in sentences, then give the integer.
A test is 99% sensitive and 95% specific. Disease prevalence is 0.4%. In prose, compute P(disease|positive) and state the percentage rounded to one decimal place.
Solve 2x^2 - 7x - 15 = 0 by completing the square, explaining each algebraic step in sentences. Give both roots as fractions.
A circle of radius 5 is centered at the origin. From point (13,0) two tangents touch the circle. In prose, find the tangent length and the points of tangency.
Use the Euclidean algorithm in prose to compute gcd(12378, 3054). Show every remainder, then express the gcd as an integer.
On an island of knights (always truth) and knaves (always lie), A says 'B is a knave' and B says 'A and I are opposite types'. Determine each type. Reason in sentences.
A 10-ft ladder slides away from a wall: the base moves at 2 ft/s. When the base is 6 ft from the wall, how fast is the top falling? Explain related rates in prose and give the value.
For matrix [[4, 1], [2, 3]], compute eigenvalues and one eigenvector per eigenvalue. Write the characteristic polynomial and the algebra in sentences.
Escribe un ensayo breve y continuo (sin listas) sobre cómo el silencio de una biblioteca cambia la forma de pensar. En español.
Schreibe einen fließenden Essay ohne Aufzählungen über das Handwerk eines Uhrmachers in einem kleinen Atelier. Auf Deutsch.
箇条書きを使わず、冬の海辺で過ごす一日について丁寧な日本語の随筆を書いてください。
用连贯的中文散文（不要列表）写一段关于深夜修理旧收音机的文字，注重声音和气味。
Escreva um ensaio contínuo em português, sem listas, sobre uma travessia de barco no início da manhã no rio.
اكتب فقرة سردية متصلة بالعربية الفصحى دون قوائم عن سوق قديم قبيل المغرب، مع وصف الأصوات والروائح.
En español, explica en un solo párrafo técnico por qué copiar una capa MoE completa por token es más caro que un gather UVA por filas.
Erkläre auf Deutsch in zusammenhängendem Text, warum ein Autotune-Hash nur bei identischer Kernel-Shape trifft.
Call tools if needed, then return ONLY a JSON object with keys host, gpu_free_mib, containers_running (integer). Use terminal to inspect this machine.
Use web_search to find the current vLLM GitHub stars, then write one sentence citing the number. If the tool is unavailable, still emit the tool call.
Read /etc/hostname with read_file, then propose a patch that appends a comment listing the hostname. Emit the tool calls; do not invent file contents.
Output a YAML document only (no prose) for a serving recipe with keys: model, port, offload_gb, util, speculative.schedule (a list of [start,end,k]), kv_gib. Use plausible DSV4.1-Flash values.
Need weather in Telluride and the UTC offset. Emit tool calls for terminal date and web_search. Do not answer without tools.
Return only JSON: {"steps":[{"n":1,"cmd":"...","why":"..."}, ...]} with exactly 4 steps to stop a vLLM container, drop caches, start it, and curl /v1/models. No markdown.
